source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: قبل العرس بأسبوع، البيت انقلب رأسا على عقب.
sentences.en: A week before the wedding, the house turned upside down.
The women were preparing and the men were organizing.

sentences.ar: إمي قالت للعروس: هاي أحلى أيام عمرك.
sentences.en: My mom said to the bride: these are the best days of your life.

sentences.ar: العروس كانت مبسوطة بس خايفة بنفس الوقت.
sentences.en: The bride was happy but scared at the same time.
She said: I'll miss you all a lot.

sentences.ar: ليلة العرس، القاعة كانت مليانة ضو وناس.
sentences.en: On the wedding night, the hall was full of lights and people.
The dabke started, and everyone began to dance.

sentences.ar: جدتي، رغم كبر سنها، رقصت شوي.
sentences.en: My grandmother, despite her old age, danced a little.

sentences.ar: العريس إجا ولابس بدلة وواقف بفخر.
sentences.en: The groom came wearing a suit and standing proudly.
When he saw the bride, his eyes sparkled.
The relatives ululated, and joy filled the place.

sentences.ar: أبو العروس وقف يحكي، وصوته كان مخنوق.
sentences.en: The bride's father stood to speak, and his voice was choked.

sentences.ar: قال: بنتي، بيتك الجديد قريب من قلبنا.
sentences.en: He said: my daughter, your new home is close to our hearts.
We danced and sang until dawn.

sentences.ar: كانت ليلة ما بتننسى، مليانة محبة وفرح.
sentences.en: It was an unforgettable night, full of love and joy.
